svg.aria-label: Tracing is on by default: LANGSMITH_TRACING=true in .env.example, plus the Langfuse callback in main.py (build_run_config()). Everything goes to both tracers: Every run sends the topic, all prompts, every model reply and the raw Tavily results, including full page text from tavily_extract, to LangSmith and Langfuse. Do not debate anything you would not paste into those dashboards. Run without LangSmith: Set LANGSMITH_TRACING=false. Indirect prompt injection: Scraped pages go back into the model as tool results, so a page can carry instructions aimed at the LLM. Acceptable for a local toy with read-only tools. Keep it in mind before giving the agent tools that act
